title: [OC] "Biologic" - An interactive particle life sim where you fight to become king of the pond.
author: Marzipug
selftext:
Try it here (Beta): [https://transcenduality.itch.io/biologic](https://transcenduality.itch.io/biologic)

Currently, this is single-player but my plans are to turn this into a multiplayer web app eventually.

The game is inspired by Agar and Spore, and aims to fuse them into the ultimate microscopic battle arena.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Marzipug please expand this post with how you used AI during development. It's not enough to say you used AI. Tell us what you did with it. The point of Rule 4 is for promotional posts to give something back by sharing the process and actual development. We're cracking down on posts that only advertise. If you don't update, this may be removed.

replies.author: Marzipug
replies.body: I used GPT to transform a normal particle life simulation (Which features particles interacting and repelling based on type, with friction), into a playable version where each 'organism' is drawn with a membrane, keeping track of which particles belong to it. Each organism has a mass which measures how many particles it contains. The goal is to become the biggest organism and not get devoured.
